7.2.23.16.3 State operation: DO_SET_CC_MODE_STOPPED ()
[SWS_CanSM_00578]
⌈As long the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_S_TX_TIMEOUT_EXCEPTION is in the state S_CC_STOPPED, the CanSM module shall operate the do action DO_SET_CC_MODE_STOPPED and therefore repeat for all configured CAN controllers of the CAN network (ref. to
[ECUC_CanSM_00141]) the API request CanIf_SetControllerMode (ref. to
[SWS_CanSM_91002]) with ControllerMode equal to CAN_CS_STOPPED, if the current CAN controller mode (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00638]) is different.⌋(SRS_Can_- 01145, SRS_Can_01142)
